notes.title: Nominate Arzette in the Steam Awards!
notes.content:
It's that time of the year again! Not only can you save a whopping [b]50% off[/b] of Arzette as part of the Steam Autumn Sale (if you or one of your friends doesn't own it yet, well...you've certainly struck luck, my friend), but you can let your voice be heard and nominate Arzette in the Steam Awards!

We recommend nominating the game for Best Soundtrack, because let's be honest...it's really good, right? Jake "Button Masher" Silverman absolutely nailed it, and it deserves to be elevated.

Otherwise, Outstanding Visual Style is the way to go! There's not a whole lot of games that look like Arzette, and a team of unbelievably talented artists worked very hard to make its very specific visual identity shine.

Whatever you choose, thank you so much for supporting Arzette - we appreciate every one of you.

Until next time!

notes.title: Arzette Mod Highlights
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We wanted to take a moment today to highlight a couple of the amazing community-made mods created for Arzette on PC.* These are free modifications that can help freshen up your play experience. We are so grateful for our fans!

[h1]Farcette[/h1]
[h2]Created by Ellie Spectacular (AKA DaThings)[/h2]

[h3][url=https://elliespectacular.com/farcette]Mod Link Here[/url][/h3]

[previewyoutube=2lRx3gsSWHA;full][/previewyoutube]

Farcette is a YTP overhaul mod that remixes and replaces every single video in the game. It also changes a lot of in-game text as well. It is structured in a way that, despite the sometimes silly and nonsensical nature of it, still follows the game’s plot & progression. There are many clever recurring jokes and callbacks to the original game. It is a huge labor of love and a super fun way to replay the game.

[h1]Randomizer Mod[/h1]
[h2]Created by Lightmopp & Dopply[/h2]

[h3][url=https://bit.ly/ArzetteRando]Mod Link Here[/url][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693323/2145c7c5aba7de51977d9f56c30122110c843fb4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693323/80e0f74f1c5d6fc62a49e28388e2218d47660a53.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693323/476db237b2f78aefed0f184893068953effe60c2.png[/img]

It’s all in the name - the randomizer mod completely randomizes the locations & unlocks of your choice of collectables, NPCs, items, beacons, and a lot more! Randomizer logic, which was painstakingly mapped out by Lightmopp and the community, ensures that the randomized seed you generate is beatable every time - even if it feels impossible! Randomizers are a great way to liven up your play experience. 

The mod includes both patch files for the game (created by Dopply), and a randomizer program which generates the file necessary to randomize the game (created by Lightmopp). Mapping logic & testing the game was a community effort - we’re still stunned a randomizer exists for the game already!



Thanks again to all of our wonderful fans who have supported Arzette. We hope to see many more community creations in the future!

*[i]Please note that technical support will not be available to those who have modified their game; please remove all mods prior to requesting technical support or filing a bug report. Use mods at your own risk. Seedy Eye Software & Limited Run Games are not responsible for any damage caused by the use of third-party user modifications.[/i]

notes.title: Arzette Update Notes 4/15/24
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we have one last big update patch for Arzette rolling out now! These are mostly minor bug fixes and small tweaks, as well as features for speedrunners and advanced users. Thank you for playing Arzette, we sincerely appreciate it! We look forward to seeing players enjoy their time in Faramore for years to come.

[h2]FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed uncommon crash error in prologue
[*] Fixed HUD text lowering in size when non-English languages are selected
[*] Various minor gameplay fixes and tweaks
[*] Various minor sprite fixes
[*] Restored last frame of cutscenes being held as the scene ends
[*] Fixed dark rooms that had lamp layering issues
[*] Fixed a variety of minor localization errors
[*] Updated credits
[*] Updated ratings for certain countries
[/list]

[h2]GAMEPLAY UPDATES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated version to 1.2.0
[*] The number indicating the active resource amounts (for example, the number of rubies you're carrying) will now turn green when that resource is maxed out
[*] Added a hidden option to skip NPC quest introduction scenes if you already have their required quest item, replicating version 1.0.0 cutscene behavior. This option can only be accessed after you've cleared the game once and set before starting a new game. 

To enable this option, once in the new game menu, hold the attack button for a moment - red warning text will appear as confirmation. Press the attack button again to disable the option.
[*] Added launch options for advanced users on Steam. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3185312203]See here for details.[/url]
[/list]

Thanks again for all of the support!

[i]Miscellaneous: The previous version of the game on Steam is accessible via the 'archive-patch' branch (alongside the original version under 'archive'). Additionally, the 'sceneskip' text file method on PC for skipping scenes has been removed in favor of the updated method, seen above.[/i]

notes.title: Arzette Patch Live!
notes.content:
Thank you so much for playing Arzette! We're still reeling from the overwhelmingly positive response. Based on community feedback, we're pleased to roll out a patch that fixes a myriad of small issues as well as added a much-requested feature - quest cutscenes for NPCs will now always play the first time!

Here is the complete list of changes:

[h2]FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*]Various minor gameplay fixes
[*]Minor localization fixes
[*]Game will now detect system language and switch automatically (language preferences can still be changed and saved)
[*]Added mouse button icons to Steam version
[*]Fixed Steam screenshots not working
[*]Fixed crash error caused by certain controllers on Steam
[*]Fixed fullscreen stretching issue on Steam version
[*]Fixed a certain unlockable mode retaining Casual difficulty
[*]Fixed background corruption in certain situations
[*]Fixed the Heart Hoarder achievement triggering during a certain mode
[*]Fixed bonus stages spitting you out of elevators too early on all platforms
[*]Fixed certain HUD elements to only display appropriately in a certain mode
[*]Fixed uneven pixel scaling with HUD elements
[*]Updated credits
[/list]


[h2]GAMEPLAY UPDATES[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added version number to title screen for all versions (version 1.1.0)
[*] Added exclamation points above important NPCs when you have items to give them
[*] NPC character's first cutscenes are always seen (currently-existing save files should see most first scenes even if character's quest is complete)
[*]Added clearer hint for Arzette Coin in the Count Denny stage
[*]Made key easier to find in Creece Canyon
[*]Removed blue magic from certain enemies in Ryha River
[*]Removed Zazie quest requirement to finish Rudy's quest
[/list]

[i]Miscellaneous: The previous version of the game on Steam is accessible via the 'archive' branch. Additionally, creating an empty text file called [b]"sceneskip"[/b] and placing it in your installation folder will restore the previous cutscene behavior. [/i]

Thanks again to everyone enjoying their journey through Faramore!

Gone are the days when gaming takes both hands to compete! Take full control of Arzette in [i]Arzette: The Jewel of Faramore[/i] and leave the others players behind as you make your way through the game at a brisk pace... you know those other players using the old-fashioned normal controllers. So, what are you waiting for? Defeat Daimur and have some fun, with the ultimate controls on the market!

Tubular design, awesome action, chicks will dig it, punks will envy you.
